title: Elizondo in Gray Fox, and JSOC's link to crash retrievals

tellings.quote: according to Future guest of this show Matthew Pines blou even was a member of the US Army intelligence support activity group otherwise known as gray fox
my buddy Matt Pines made the connection that Lou Alzando is actually part of this group called Gray Fox.
tellings.link_reason: Both relay Matt Pines's claim that Elizondo was a member of Gray Fox (the Intelligence Support Activity).

plain: Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, was once a member of Gray Fox, which Michels describes as the US Army's intelligence support activity group, a secretive unit tied to the military's special operations command. Michels says this twice, both times passing on what he was told by Matthew Pines, a friend who later came on the show, and in one telling he places it in the 2000s. If true, it would put Elizondo inside the special operations world that some link to recovering crashed objects.
